description: End-to-end execution of release v2.0.0 (commit 02b4566bb6e8d5db0eec516ccce7e496fcc49d9c) on the real dataset: download, verify, cohorts, train (4 models x 5 runs), evaluate, sensitivity, tables, figures, compare.

environment.installation: fresh virtual environment; offline hash-pinned installation of the 20 wheels of environment/requirements-g4.lock (public-index reachability not tested); matplotlib installed only for the figures stage
environment.hardware: the reference laptop of the study (Intel i5-12450H, 16 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 3050 Laptop GPU 4 GB)
environment.data: the 24 pinned LAMDA files from a locally verified copy, re-verified (size, SHA-256, footers, schema, rows)

scope: Exact reproduction under the tested environment and installation procedure. Bit-identity on other hardware, GPUs, drivers or operating systems has not been tested.
